about: How what ROUNDS does to an opponent lands on a VS enemy. ROUNDS decides it with its own code (in the hidden ROUNDS, against the mirrored enemy); VS shows it with its own systems.

rows.rounds: a bullet, explosion, saw or aura hit with ROUNDS's damage
rows.vs: EnemyController.GetDamaged with ROUNDS damage x damageScale x the shooter's VS Might (PPower): VS's own damage numbers, hit flash, knockback, death, gems and gold

rows.rounds: poison, Parasite, Toxic Cloud ticks, summed per ROUNDS frame
rows.vs: GetDamaged without knockback or hit effect
a flat amount instead (bosses would melt)

rows.rounds: Cold Bullets, Frost Slam, Chilling Presence, Static Field slows (ROUNDS caps at 0.9)
rows.vs: EnemyController.SlowEnemy for the slow's ROUNDS decay time
EnemyController.DoDefang: the enemy deals no damage for the time

rows.rounds: knockback, Implode, Tractor Beam, Saw, Thruster velocity changes on a 100-mass body
rows.vs: the enemy is moved by the push (small enemies; bosses only flinch)

rows.rounds: King Midas (card mod) turns an enemy gold
rows.vs: a lasting 50% slow on that enemy
